title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Sick
An inmate with an influential family in one gang, joins its arch rival; a female inmate who has ties to both gangs finds her mail has jail officials concerned.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Lightning Voltz
The Louisville Metro Department of Corrections Jail has a daily population of about 2,000 men and women charged with anything from minor crimes to capital murder; both buildings are overcrowded, and their layouts are outdated.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Enough is Enough
A repeat offender smuggles in contraband and an inmate becomes a marked man after murdering a Louisville rap star; a prescription pill epidemic takes its toll on the jail and drug use on the inside could keep another inmate from leaving.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — X'd Out
In San Antonio, Texas, rival gangs shed blood in a power struggle to control a wide range of criminal activity including drugs, prostitution and human trafficking; this turf war has expanded from the streets to inside the walls of Bexar County Jail.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Defiance
Gang members disrupt a housing unit, and when inmates flood their cells, the Special Emergency Response Team, or SERT, takes action, placing one inmate in special restraints; a female inmate poses a dangerous threat to staff.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E7 — Tangled Web
Police take a young man into custody following the murder of a 15-year-old boy in his Louisville, Ky., home; the jail finds itself with a multitude of related high-profile cases.

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — The Box Life
For inmates that reach their boiling point, the jail has a special place: The Box; as one inmate says, "separated from everything so you learn to deal with it. It's called 'The Box Life.'".

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E2 — Secrets of the Transy Book Heist
Four clean-cut college students risk it all to become super-thieves by targeting $12 million in rare books in a brash daylight heist that baffles the cops hunting them.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E4 — The Inside Job
When a violent gang of bank robbers executes a perfect heist, cops don't realize that one of the terrified bank tellers is actually the mastermind behind it all.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E6 — The Heist of the Century
TV cameras are there when armed bank robbers take hostages at a large, international bank; police don't realize the robbery only masks a more spectacular heist taking place right under their feet.
